column1: # Canonical privacy scale (Ostler). ONE table, byte-identical in every repo that reads or writes a level.
# Pinned by sha256 in each repo (test_privacy_scale_shared.py). Change it here and re-pin every copy in one held set.
# Never copy these values into code: load them through privacy_scale.py (the tiny loader that sits next to this file).
# Direction: L0 least private (no protection, public) ... L3 most private (owner-only). Rank 3 = most private.
# Fail closed: a missing, empty, unknown or unparseable level is L3.
# Rulings: owner 2026-11-16 ("L3 was most secure / owner only, and L0 was no protection / public");

column3: personal; leaves the owner's own surfaces only in redacted form
private / sensitive; may reach the owner's own brief, never a cloud model, other people or an export
most private, owner-only; never leaves the box

column1: # Written next to the level by every writer converted to this scale (design PR 2), and by the relabel (PR 4).
# A reader treats L0 WITH this stamp as canonical L0. An L0 WITHOUT it is legacy (see [legacy]) until the relabel.
# outbound_rule(level, destination): full = may leave as is; redacted = only its redacted form; labelled = owner-local, shown with the private label and the one-time note; no = withheld.
# Every Hub route is outbound unless proven owner-local. An unknown destination is read as the "unknown" row (the strictest).
# thread_participants: a reply drafted INTO a thread may draw on THAT thread's own content at L0-L2. An L3 thread never produces a draft.
# Any OTHER owner data pulled into that draft (other threads, facts, calendar, people) is checked against the "others" row,
# not this one: only L0, or L1 in redacted form. Minors follow the existing minors ruling on top of this table.
# Labels written under an OLD scale, before that store's per-writer relabel (design section 2, PR 4).
# An L0 is legacy exactly when it carries no [scale_stamp] value.
# Only rows the owner has ruled are listed. treat_as applies on every outbound path until the relabel proves 0 meaning-down-moves.
# The rest of the per-writer mapping is a DRAFT awaiting Archie's row-by-row approval and is NOT in this table.

column3: LEGACY-AMBIGUOUS: old PWG / CM041 L0 meant owner-private
